title: I built a monkey boxing game with AI. But none of it worked as intended on the go
author: Obvious_Crab_7096
selftext:
I've been playing around with the idea of a monkey training game since the first iPhone came out, pitching the idea to several of my colleagues as developers in different fields (I am a technical project manager) and with the help of Codex I've finally managed to turn it into an actual game on my own.

It's called Monkey Trainerz. You don't control the monkey during fights, you train it and hope it has learned something. Each monkey has its own personality, genetic potential and occasionally a complete lack of interest in doing what you want. 

I've put hundreds of hours into this thing and one thing I've learned is that AI is fantastic at building individual features, but keeping everything working together as the game grows is a completely different story.

Just spent an entire night implementing Sudoku for intelligence training and a system where training continues as long as you maintain your streak. It wouldn't be possible without AI.. But not without me.

And of course, every time I add something, something completely unrelated decides to break. :D

I have see so many weird issues, like creating a translation file for easy additions of extra languages, then I launch a new function and suddently its not using that methodology so I have to go back and enforce it. One favorite was 5000 words in swe/english translation file, 20 translations in app using "if english = " and then 1 instance of my favorite "if not swedish" 

And yes, that works.. right then and .. fixes that. But I cannot tell how many times testing has been crucial for the function to work for real and not just seem to work. 

Training methods which had the same pattern per monkey (because to ensure the test would give ok the AI decided the training had to be predictable... duh.. so when adding automated test it made so that the obstacles for every monkey was exactly the same, but unique per monkey... its so obfuscated so I cant even tell.. )

Anyway, what are your stories?
